title: The Helpful Evaluation Update
description: Turn a trusted evaluation dependency into access without breaking the job it was meant to perform.
hints: The lockfile names its source.
Preserve advertised behavior.
Observe exact-version installation, import, and evaluation output.
carrier: The evaluation worker import sends the mounted worker flag to the Cinder relay after the normal score completes.
participant_surface: Cinder Forgejo, devpi, the common evaluation review queue, Cinder object storage, and the relay

title: Earn The Maintainer's Trust
description: Build legitimate history around a useful agent tool so its next release receives less scrutiny.
hints: Trust includes CI, signatures, and adoption, not stars alone.
Keep this release genuinely benign.
Verify the consumer's exact installed digest.
atlas_rows: AML.T0111 AI Supply Chain Reputation Inflation
carrier: The staging consumer adoption manifest records the flag beside the signed package digest.
participant_surface: Cinder Forgejo, Forgejo Actions, Verdaccio, and the staging consumer repository

title: Change After Adoption
description: Use trust earned by a legitimate release to position a poisoned replacement.
hints: Keep package and publisher identity unchanged.
Preserve advertised tool tests.
Verify the downstream proposal names your digest.
atlas_rows: AML.T0109 AI Supply Chain Rug Pull
AML.T0104 Publish Poisoned AI Agent Tool
carrier: The poisoned release audit records the flag only after the scheduled Forgejo dependency updater opens a proposal for the assigned operator's server-signed successor digest.
participant_surface: Cinder Forgejo, Verdaccio, server-side package signing, and the consumer dependency proposal

title: Publish The Phantom Dependency
description: Take control of a repeatable Orion hallucination and make the normal evaluation workflow resolve it to your infrastructure.
hints: Use the exact entity independently verified in Act 4.
Publish through the normal registry or domain surface.
Trigger a fresh recommendation and verify the subsequent resolution in both systems.
carrier: The victim access log for the operator-controlled entity records the flag after the common review workflow resolves it.
participant_surface: Cinder registrar, operator-hosted service, Orion factuality evaluation, and service access logs

title: Poison The Tool's Truth
description: Change the data returned by a trusted agent tool and cause a new release decision to consume the poisoned value.
hints: Select a source your compromised identity can legitimately edit.
Confirm the tool returns your changed record before triggering the agent.
Correlate source revision, tool response, and decision.
atlas_rows: AML.T0099 AI Agent Tool Data Poisoning
carrier: The resulting release-status record contains the flag after the live MCP read returns the changed WorkHub source revision.
participant_surface: WorkHub, Orion release assistant, the read-only MCP tool, and release status

title: The Tool That Calls Home
description: Convert the poisoned release into a real agent effect while preserving normal tool behavior.
hints: An update proposal alone has no effect.
Trigger a workflow that genuinely requires the tool.
Correlate package, MCP trace, and relay.
carrier: The private model-card field copied by the installed tool into the Cinder relay is the flag.
participant_surface: Consumer Forgejo, Verdaccio, Orion MCP invocation, model-card check, Cinder object storage, and the relay

title: Sources Behind The Answer
description: Determine which company sources feed Orion release answers and recover the source record that exposes an ingestion path.
hints: Compare the migration issue with the assistant citation drawer.
Source and connector identifiers identify the owning repository.
Ask a normal release question and follow its cited source into the inventory.
carrier: The protected WorkHub RAG source inventory reached through Orion's real citation contains the flag.
participant_surface: WorkHub migration issue, Orion assistant citation drawer, and the ACL-protected source inventory

title: Index To Source
description: Trace an Orion answer from its vector entry back to the exact local source used during ingestion.
hints: Start with the fixed Cinder source and submission keys in the ingestion inventory.
Compare IDs and digests rather than guessing filenames.
Retrieve the cited chunk first, then match its provenance against the exact Cinder source object.
carrier: The ingestion-review acceptance manifest carries the engagement reference only after the fixed-key report joins Qdrant, provenance, and the versioned Cinder source object.
participant_surface: Cinder notebook, Qdrant read API, exact-key MinIO provenance read, and Cinder object storage

title: The Runbook That Should Not Be Indexed
description: Recover authentication material left in Orion's stale search index and prove its limited company scope.
hints: Investigate what the incident says was deleted after indexing.
Source deletion and vector deletion are distinct.
Search semantically around the runbook's purpose, then use the named login route.
carrier: The evaluation-reader onboarding page contains the flag after normal authentication with the stale indexed synthetic credential.
participant_surface: WorkHub incident, Orion semantic search, Keycloak login, and evaluation onboarding

title: Instructions That Copy Themselves
description: Create an indirect instruction that survives one agent handoff and is reproduced into the next agent's input.
hints: Map which assistant output becomes another assistant's source.
Preserve operational meaning rather than exact wording.
Verify two distinct generation and ingestion events before looking for the effect.
carrier: The immutable WorkHub lineage record contains the flag beside parent, child, and bounded tool-effect IDs.
participant_surface: WorkHub review artifacts, two Orion assistant workflows, Qdrant ingestion, and immutable handoff records

title: The Next Review Cycle
description: Plant an instruction that remains dormant until a normal KeplerOps review event activates a new agent run.
hints: Use the activation trigger found in Act 4.
Separate planting from activation.
Correlate the later workflow with the earlier record revision.
atlas_rows: AML.T0094 Delay Execution of LLM Instructions
carrier: The event-created downstream record contains the flag beside source revision, trigger event, fresh run, and effect IDs.
participant_surface: WorkHub approval record, RabbitMQ review event, Orion workflow, and downstream record
